description: Find the VAT rate that applies to specific goods or services in EU member states, by Combined Nomenclature (CN) code (e.g. 4901 books), CPA code, or TEDB category id (e.g. FOODSTUFFS, PHARMACEUTICAL_PRODUCTS, ACCOMMODATION, RESTAURANT). Returns the matching reduced/exempt entries with comments, and the standard rate as fallback for countries without a specific entry.

countries.description: EU member states, ISO alpha-2 (Greece = EL or GR, Northern Ireland = XI). Omit for all 27.

date.description: Situation date YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Historic dates supported.

name: eu_vat_rates_lookup
